name: Dynamic Santorini 1-2 Person Full Spectrum Near-Zero EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Santorini 1-2 Person Full Spectrum Near-Zero EMF (Under 3 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Want to turn your home into a personal wellness retreat? Dynamic Saunas are built from eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood, combining strength and style. With advanced Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels, they deliver gentle, energy-efficient warmth that relieves stress, improves circulation, and restores natural balance. Easy to install, these saunas fit perfectly in basements, master baths, walk-in closets, or even home gyms. Compact yet elegant, they blend seamlessly into your space while offering daily relaxation and long-lasting health benefits. A Dynamic Sauna isn’t just home luxury, it’s an investment in your well-being. Features: Near-zero EMF - EMF under 3 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels 1-2 person capacity 6 Total Heaters, 4 PureTech™ Near-Zero EMF (Under 3 mg) inches from the heating elements) FAR IR Carbon Heating Panels, 2 Near IR Elements Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Therapy Feature Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speaker 118F-132F is the deal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Clasp together assembly Roof vent Ships in 1 box Note: Indoor use only Specifications: Sauna weight: 250 lbs. Shipping weight: 265 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp Non GFCI plug & play (Recommended Dedicated Outlet) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 36″+ 2" x 39″ x 77″ Document: View Owner's Manual
